body.statement: For every \(T\ge2\), \(C>0\), and known \(\beta>0\), choose \(b_T=\lceil T^{1/(2\beta+1)}\rceil\). Then \[R_T^{(2)}(\beta;B,C)\le K_+(B,C,\beta)T^{-2\beta/(2\beta+1)}.\] The same conclusion holds with the smallest certified integer \(b\) substituted for \(b_T\).
body.justification: This audited supporting theorem records the constructive half of the oracle frontier in squared loss with an explicit constant.
body.gap: The rate-attaining Markov construction is inherited from the banked predecessor; the contribution here is only the corrected MSE accounting and finite-horizon audit, not a separate novelty claim.
body.consumer: Statsig-style and marketplace experiment owners can translate a known decay index into an assignment-window length before launch.
